summary: This is a well-targeted, additive fix for the real PR #84 incident (independently confirmed via `gh pr view 84`: state MERGED, mergedAt 2026-07-26T10:19:37Z): the new PR-URL-resolution guard in supervisor-entrypoint.sh correctly fails loud and checkpoints 'blocked' instead of letting an unresolved PR_URL fall through to gh's dangerous empty-argument branch-based fallback, it is placed at the correct point in the script (immediately after PR_URL is written, before any gh pr comment/merge call uses it), and every new/pre-existing test (supervisor_pr_url_guard_test.sh, supervisor_sweep_discovery_test.sh, test_veridian_task_adopt.py, test_merge_execution.py) passes when run for real against the actual shipped scripts rather than a reimplementation. The new supervisor-sweep.sh safety net and veridian-task.py `adopt` command are reasonable, narrowly scoped, and exercised by real git-worktree-based tests including the worktree-conflict fallback path. No .github/workflows/** changes, no auth/db/payment/schema paths touched -- tier1 classification is correct. Two process concerns are worth the Owner's attention even though they don't change my verdict on this diff's code quality: (1) /opt/veridian/scripts/supervisor-entrypoint.sh and /opt/veridian/scripts/supervisor-sweep.sh already exist live in production with content byte-identical to this PR, despite master not having these changes and deploy-live-scripts.sh only ever pulling from master -- meaning these two files were pushed to production through some out-of-band path that bypassed this exact PR/audit/merge pipeline, which is the kind of unaudited production write this task's own incident is about; (2) the task title's claim to 'register orphan recovery PR84 for real audit' was not actually carried out -- no adopted task_dir exists for PR84 yet, only the `adopt` capability was added in code, so that part of the title overstates what this diff actually accomplished.
issues: Live production copies of scripts/supervisor-entrypoint.sh and scripts/supervisor-sweep.sh at /opt/veridian/scripts/ already match this diff byte-for-byte even though master doesn't have these changes and the normal deploy-live-scripts.sh path only syncs from master -- indicates an out-of-band production deployment bypassed the PR/audit/merge gate this task exists to protect; worth a real investigation into how/who deployed it, separate from this PR's own merits.

Task title claims PR #84 was registered for real audit via `adopt`, but no adopted task_dir exists yet -- only the `adopt` command itself was implemented and tested; the actual registration of PR84 is still an outstanding follow-up action, not something this diff completed.
